voice.name: James - Professional
voice.note: West Country 50-year-old, slight accent — a Wiltshire magistrate, dry and exact

segments.t_open: The drummer was locked in a gaol cell, two counties away. His drum sat silent in my house. [pause] And still, every night — the drumming.
segments.t_s1: A vagrant drummer, begging with forged passes. I was the magistrate; I had the drum taken off him. A court matter. Paperwork. [soft laugh] The bailiff sent the drum to my house. And the first night, the banging began — on the doors, on the roof. Then drumming. From the air above my own chimneys.
segments.t_s2: It came indoors, to the children's room. Their bedframes beaten. Scratching under them — loud, like claws. My children were shaken, and lifted, in their beds. [pause] It would make chairs, tables, trunks — all moveables — walk up and down the rooms. Lights, moving with no hand to carry them. A panting, like a dog. And a smell of sulphur after.
segments.t_s3: Any man who doubted was welcome to a bed. The blacksmith took one — and a pair of pincers snapped at his nose the whole night through. [soft laugh] Then a clergyman came, a scholar, Glanvill, to test it. He stood in the children's chamber, their hands in plain view above the covers, and heard the scratching beneath them — as loud, he wrote, as long nails upon a bolster. He searched the room. Nothing.
segments.t_s4: The drummer sat in Gloucester gaol for theft. A Wiltshire man visited, and the drummer asked how I fared — and then he said it: it was because he took my drum from me. He shall never have his quiet again, till I have my drum, or satisfaction. [pause] They tried him under the Witchcraft Act. Over a drum. He was transported to the colonies.
segments.t_s5: Two years, it went on. And worse than the noise was the talk — that I had contrived it all, for profit or for attention. [exhales] I sent liars to the assizes for a living; now I was called one. I wrote it down while it was happening, and the letters were printed, and years later, when they whispered that I had confessed a trick — I set my denial in writing too. It was no imposture. Make of it what you will.

small: The witness is the town's magistrate.

yt_title: Tedworth: The Drummer Was in Prison
